result: A survey of non-convex optimization theory: complexity of reaching ε-stationary points (deterministic, stochastic, variance-reduced, lower bounds), problem classes with global guarantees such as the Polyak–Łojasiewicz condition, and higher- and zeroth-order methods.
result_plain: Survey of non-convex complexity theory: stationarity rates, PL and other structured classes, higher- and zeroth-order methods.
